title: Funnel and Conversion Intelligence
description: Analyze signup-to-purchase funnels, detect conversion changes, and attribute them to the responsible segment, page, device, or source with session evidence — your AI Growth Analyst's conversion readout.
setup_prompt: Use Funnel and Conversion Intelligence for my AI Growth Analyst. With my reconciled growth data, apply my funnel definitions and segments, monitor conversion for supported changes, attribute drops to segment or surface with session evidence, and produce evidence-backed findings without guessing at causes.

setup_inputs.label: Reconciled Growth Data Foundation or equivalent model
Funnel and step definitions with targets
Session-replay consent, access, and sampling policy
Minimum freshness, coverage, and confidence policy

recommended_tools.name: PostHog, Mixpanel, or Amplitude MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized funnels, trends, and segment breakdowns behind a finding

recommended_tools.name: PostHog, FullStory, or Contentsquare MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Pull consented session replays linked to a conversion change for qualitative evidence

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks workflow database
recommended_tools.purpose: Persist funnel snapshots, investigations, findings, and follow-up outcomes

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether funnel insight explains acquisition and conversion outcomes
Actionability, measurement cost, and decision value
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge
